validation_rules: Every declared rejection_code SHALL be an ACTIVE rejection-code registry entry.
Every declared HTTP status SHALL equal the active registry default_http_status unless an explicit documented exception is recorded.
The authoritative YAML harness and Markdown mirror SHALL declare the same vector identifiers and names.
Every expected HTTP status for every primary request and HTTP setup prestep SHALL be declared by the matched IF-001 OpenAPI operation.
Every normative Error Mapping statement that classifies a failure as governance-significant SHALL preserve the Core Governance Evidence obligation and SHALL NOT weaken it with SHOULD language.

Active normative Error Mapping terminology SHALL identify DS-026 Governance Approval Artifact as the approval and adjudication representation; Human Review Artifact MAY appear only in explicit legacy, retirement, or historical context, while Pending Human Review remains a controlled governance outcome.
closure_statement: Every harness rejection-code/status pair matches the active rejection registry default and every expected status is declared by the matched IF-001 operation.

governance_evidence_obligation_validatio.policy_module_registration_failure_rule: SHALL produce Governance Evidence where sufficient attribution context exists
governance_evidence_obligation_validatio.governance_policy_registration_failure_r: SHALL produce Governance Evidence where sufficient attribution context exists
